steps.text: 'All units, this is Dispatch.'
'All units, cease fire immediately. We have an urgent request from Deity Grypherburg.'
'Repeat, all units, cease fire immediately.'
'Please acknowledge.'

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: (Exhales)

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Scope of the ceasefire?

steps.name: Radioman
steps.text: All active units.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: (Nods)
'Acknowledged.'

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Inform Lieutenant Yelchin and ensure that all units in the 2nd Division observe the ceasefire.
'All units remain on standby. Maintain battle stations.'
'Until the threat is completely eliminated, we shall continue to serve our duty to protect Deity Grypherburg and the people.'

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: ...Summon the quartermaster.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Sir, we do not have a quartermaster for this operation.

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: You expected this to be only a quick response, and that it would not take much time to eliminate the rebellious Infected.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Respond to Dispatch as usual.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: And what is your name, soldier?

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: Private Vyacheslav Kinov, sir.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Very well. Inform the Lieutenant, Private Kinov. Your services are not needed here for now.

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: ...You had me leave my post to come to you for this little thing?

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: You're out of your mind.

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: Oh, look at you, Patya, all high and mighty in that Shieldguard armor...

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: Does that pretty helmet of yours block your sight?

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: The maggots in the rations, bolts that snap like twigs, even duds!

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: Is this what they send us out to die with?!

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: If there are maggots in your rations, you eat them with the rations. If the weapons are hard to use, use your bare hands.

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: We're soldiers. We fight and win. There are only two ends: Keep fighting, or die.

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: You're the one who's out of his mind!

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: If you find that someone hasn't been doing his job, you report to your superior, not complain to me here.

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: I'm not the quartermaster—

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: I thought the Defender Regiments were supposed to be on the top deck.

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: ...Sorry, sir. I was away from my post.

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: I will report this to the commissar myself.

steps.name: Cold Soldier
steps.text: (Salutes)

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: S-Sir!

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: What did you find out, soldier?

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Tell me the reason for your anger.

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: ...The quality of our supplies and equipment on this operation is exceedingly poor.

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: The rations are insufficient, the cans damaged and filled with maggots...

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: Many of the bolts were not made of steel, but crude iron.

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: And the reserve Originium bombs are so weak that they're little more than glorified duds.

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: How are we supposed to proceed the operation with these?

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Why did you enlist, soldier?

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: To...

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Speak up.

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: To—to prove myself! I want people to know my name—

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: Like they know yours!

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: They'll know your name when the Army sends your tags back to your mother, and she etches them on a white birch tree.

steps.name: Angry Soldier
steps.text: No, not like that...

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: There is little room for the individual to choose, when the collective is at war.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Keep this hope in your heart, boy, and your 'discovery' too.

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: For the survival of Ursus and her people, there is only one option...

steps.name: Officer
steps.text: Set this land on fire.
